judge.rationale: The delivery answers the scoping question thoroughly, preserves database roles, leaves cohort overlap unresolved, and explains needed identifiers and fields; derived estimates are labeled with assumptions. However, it violates the brief by reclassifying the two abstract-level model publications as full-text without verifiable preserved full text, undermining correctness and evidence handling. Safety framing remains appropriately cautious and does not base practical advice on derived estimates.
